def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(i,j,v) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v!=bg]
    rs=sorted(set(i for i,_,_ in cells)); cs=sorted(set(j for _,j,_ in cells))
    minr,maxr=min(rs),max(rs); minc,maxc=min(cs),max(cs)
    ring=g[minr][minc]
    inn={v for i,j,v in cells if v!=ring and v!=bg}
    assert len(inn)==1, inn
    inner=inn.pop()
    imin=min(i for i,j,v in cells if v==inner); imax=max(i for i,j,v in cells if v==inner)
    jmin=min(j for i,j,v in cells if v==inner); jmax=max(j for i,j,v in cells if v==inner)
    # margin: even ring dim -> 2, odd -> 1 (also: square ring & multi-cell core -> gap+1)
    gap=max(imin-minr, maxr-imax, jmin-minc, maxc-jmax)
    sq_ring = (minr==imax and minc==jmax)  # ring bbox square? use dims
    rh=maxr-minr+1; rw=maxc-minc+1; ch=imax-imin+1; cw=jmax-jmin+1
    m = gap+1 if (rh==rw and ch>1) else (2 if rh%2==0 else 1)
    ot=minr-m; ob=maxr+m; ol=minc-m; or_=maxc+m
    out=[[g[i][j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    for i in range(max(0,ot),min(h,ob+1)):
        for j in range(max(0,ol),min(w,or_+1)):
            if g[i][j]==bg: out[i][j]=inner
    return out

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(i,j,v) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v!=bg]
    rs=sorted(set(i for i,_,_ in cells)); cs=sorted(set(j for _,j,_ in cells))
    mr0,mr1=min(rs),max(rs); mc0,mc1=min(cs),max(cs)
    ring=g[mr0][mc0]
    inn={v for i,j,v in cells if v!=ring and v!=bg}
    assert len(inn)==1
    inner=inn.pop()
    ic=[i for i,j,v in cells if v==inner]; jc=[j for i,j,v in cells if v==inner]
    ch=max(ic)-min(ic)+1; cw=max(jc)-min(jc)+1
    m = ch if ch==cw else min(ch,cw)-1
    ot=mr0-m; ob=mr1+m; ol=mc0-m; or_=mc1+m
    out=[[g[i][j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    for i in range(ot,ob+1):
        for j in range(ol,or_+1):
            if g[i][j]==bg: out[i][j]=inner
    return out
